A Gift for the Governor

Governor Valrasian has hinted that he would appreciate an arrow from a Blue Clan forester mage. Obtain one: the governor's displeasure would bring nothing good.

Objectives

Go to the Blue Clan's domain

Find the forester mage

Collect the arrow

Locations

Maps
Mining district
